summary: The false gated-auth blocker is resolved. Remote Alpamayo commands now preserve the logged-in Hugging Face auth home while still using workspace model caches, and the RunPod proof completed two live CARLA + Alpamayo paused closed-loop iterations plus a scored 60s video.

finding_log.summary: The hero MP4 is still remote-only, so final submission packaging must pull or host it before marking the media as local or public.
evidence: MEM-0033 requires public_url/local_file/remote_only distinction for final media evidence.
finding_log.next_action: Pull or host the MP4 during final packaging; do not mark it public/local until exported.

rubric_sections.name: code-quality
findings: The fix is a narrow environment-contract repair in the remote Alpamayo scripts, covered by bash syntax checks and regression tests that prevent reintroducing the auth-home override.

rubric_sections.name: evidence-quality
findings: Evidence covers the root cause, the fixed auth behavior, a two-step live CARLA Alpamayo run, closed-loop scores, and video score. Inspectability is slightly reduced because the MP4 remains on the RunPod filesystem.
rubric_sections.next_action: Pull or host media before final submission packaging.

rubric_sections.name: integration-readiness
findings: The dependency contract is now explicit: RunPod must preserve HF auth home and may override only the model cache directories. This is recorded in MEM-0049 and tested across the Alpamayo remote scripts.
rubric_sections.next_action: Keep MEM-0049 in future RunPod/Alpamayo wrappers.

rubric_sections.name: video-quality
findings: The scored video passes the mechanical closed-loop-video gate with 60s/720 frames and model-driven policy credit, while preserving `real_time_vla_control=false`.
rubric_sections.next_action: Export media locally or publicly for judge packaging.

next_action: Proceed with final media export/hosting if the user wants judge-facing packaging; auth is no longer the blocker.
